item.title: Venezuelan soccer player's ICE detention highlights immigration backlog
item.description: The case of Homero Calderón illustrates the severe delays in the U.S. immigration system.

item.title: Five exercises to ease and prevent pregnancy discomfort
item.description: Pregnancy often brings aches like hemorrhoids and leg cramps. These exercises can help reduce pain.

item.title: Afghan interpreters who aided U.S. troops now fear losing green card status
item.description: Five years after the U.S. withdrawal from Afghanistan, many Afghan allies resettled in America are anxious about their immigration status.

item.title: Powerful 7.7 magnitude earthquake hits Indonesia coast, killing at least 38
item.description: A strong 7.7 magnitude earthquake struck off Indonesia's coast early Saturday, killing at least 38 people and collapsing buildings.
